Description:

Being wireless, it is ultra-mobile and can be very easily implemented. This allows BlinkSight solution to be adapted to every implementation configuration.

The BlinkSight solution is composed not only of physical elements (beacons, tags) but also of a software suite, which allows the visualization and the exploitation of the gathered data. It is based on a radio pulse technology which guarantees a precise response time measurement and is robust even in industrial environments.

Real time location of elements allows the adaptation of an environment or the optimization of an organization.
Data gathered by the dispositive create an evolving and dynamic vision as opposed to the long and costly studies of consultant offices.

Thanks to the collection of subtle signals, the BlinkSight solution allows pre-warnings before the actual loss of value (disaffection for a product, securing of personal,...). It also allows the elaboration of solutions and directions for improvement. 
By allowing users to see in real time and to understand instantly what is going on, BlinkSight gives the power to enterprises to reach a reactivity level unknown up to now.

The BlinkSight solution does not only gather this information, it gives sense to it and makes it smarter.

* RFC 8724: SCHC Generic Framework for LPWAN
* RFC 9011: SCHC over LoRaWAN
* RFC 8824: SCHC for CoAP 
* SCHC over NB-IoT (in the making)
* SCHC over Sigfox (in the making)

As the international leader of SCHC, Acklio's software enhances the efficiency, accelerates the time to market and ensures the long-term sustainability of IoT solutions.

Main use cases: 
* Deployment of smart electricity meters over LoRaWAN (DLMS over LoRaWAN) 
* Reducing data traffic on cellular IoT implementation (60%+ gains)
* Supporting IPv6 over LPWAN (for smart utilities, industry 4.0, smart building, smart home, ...)

Name: NetCollectif
Description:
Aujourd'hui, nous avons tous internet à la maison, c'est devenu presque aussi important que l'électricité, l'eau chaude ou le chauffage.
Pourtant, à l'heure du changement climatique, de la sobriété, et de la pénurie des ressources nécessaires au fonctionnement du monde numérique, un grand gaspillage structurel est organisé.
Toutes les box internet domestiques sont dimensionnées pour répondre aux besoins des utilisateurs les plus exigeants, obligeant chacun à souscrire des abonnements coûteux et largement surdimensionnés par rapport à ses besoins. Par exemple, on considère qu'un débit de 25Mb/s est suffisant pour regarder la télévision en 4K ou jouer en ligne en UHD. Or ces usages sont ceux qui consomment le plus de bande passante, et pourtant les box internet fibre oscille entre 400Mb/s et vont jusqu'à 8Gb/s.
De plus, la couverture Wi-Fi dépasse souvent largement le périmètre de la maison, ce qui fait qu'on se retrouve souvent à capter 10 réseaux différents chez soi, vous pouvez faire le test dès maintenant .

Avec NetCollectif, nous souhaitons changer de paradigme afin de proposer un accès internet à un prix attractif, calibré en fonction de réels besoins et mutualisé afin de réduire les impacts écologiques (moins de matériel → moins d'impact).

Name: APEX Technologies, France
Description:
For over 25 years, APEX Technologies has been designing and manufacturing ultra-high-performance optical test and measurement instruments that push the limits of precision and speed. Initially recognized for pioneering the world’s first commercially available ultra-high-resolution Optical Spectrum Analyzer, APEX Technologies continues to lead innovation in optical metrology with a growing portfolio of advanced solutions.

Today, APEX Technologies supports a broad spectrum of industries, including telecommunications, datacom, energy, aerospace, defense, and healthcare. Our instruments are trusted on production floors and in front-line research labs alike — from academic and private institutes to corporate R&D laboratories around the world. With over 500 units installed in more than 30 countries, APEX Technologies has earned the confidence of researchers and engineers worldwide.

Our expanding product range includes Optical Frequency Domain Reflectometers (OFDR), tunable laser sources, broadband ASE sources, polarimeters, and our renowned Optical Complex Spectrum Analyzers (OCSA) and Optical Spectrum Analyzers (OSA) — still among the most precise on the market, with resolution down to 0.04 pm.

Building on decades of experience, we are pursuing an ambitious development roadmap focused on next-generation electro-optical devices, integrated photonics, frequency-comb measurement, and quantum technologies. Guided by our belief that knowledge is power, we remain committed to providing cutting-edge tools that enable our customers to see deeper, measure faster, and innovate further.

In 2005, the "Ordre des Géomètres Experts created the GNSS TERIA network and the EXAGONE company in charge of its implementation and management.

Name: Rogervoice
Description:
Rogervoice is an app that enriches connections between people, anytime and anywhere, through an accessible, simple and innovative telephone experience.

Rogervoice is a mobile app that enables deaf and hard-of-hearing persons to call, either using speech-recognition technology to transcribe conversations in real-time or using video-relay calls with a sign-language interpreter. Rogervoice makes phone calls accessible in more than 6 different communication modes. 

A social venture, impacting the lives of thousands of people, Rogervoice is a very human project. The Rogervoice team is a blend of skills, techniques, and sensibilities, coming from many different profiles, but above all we’re a committed and mission-driven team. 

Over 75 million people worldwide cannot call because of their hearing loss. The startup founded by deaf entrepreneur Olivier Jeannel in 2014 now enables mobile carriers such as Orange as well as major call centers such as FedEx and Teleperformance, to offer accessible telephony services to their customers. Available in 52 countries, Rogervoice serves over 40.000 active users. 

As such, people who could not make phone calls can now have conversations with their family, their friends, or customer care services, without having to rely on others.  

The Rogervoice platform combines artificial and human intelligence within a modular and robust telephone architecture that handles real-time audio, in order to offer a new experience in telecommunications: immediate and accurate captions of phone calls. 

Rogervoice makes life easier for deaf, hard-of-hearing and deafblind persons and their families and friends, with a simple app on your smartphone.

Name: OneAccess
Description:
OneAccess Networks, now an Ekinops company, is a leading provider of physical and virtual network functions enabling Cloud and other managed services to SMB and enterprise customers around the world.

For over a decade, OneAccess has been delivering enterprise network functions designed specifically for service providers’ needs: performance in compact multi-service access routers.

Our approach to virtualization takes this philosophy forward. Network operators and CSPs have told us they want a catalog of compact, efficient, carrier-grade VNFs delivered on an open, standards-based platform that allows them to stay in control. They want the ability to integrate third party network functions as they see fit. Plus they need a phased approach to NFV migration, at a pace which they define. So that’s what we deliver, today: fast network virtualization

29 of the top 100 service providers in the world have already chosen OneAccess to enhance their competitive edge. Now they can do so using state-of-the-art, open virtualization technology.

OneAccess is headquartered in Vélizy-Villacoublay near Paris in France, with sales offices strategically located around the world.

Name: Cellhire
Description:
Cellhire is a global telecoms provider of mobile communications, M2M/IoT services and data connectivity.
 
Established in 1987 the Group serves EMEA, Americas and APAC with offices in the UK, USA, France, Germany and Japan. Partnering with MNO’s globally, Cellhire provides access to mobile connectivity at market-leading commercials to companies and Indirect partners worldwide.
 
Cellhire is at the forefront of the growing IoT market, having developed extensive IoT capabilities such as Fixed IP, IoT SIMs, eSIM and Multi-IMSI. In addition Cellhire is a Full MVNO of Orange in France, under the brand ‘eSIMsmart’ and is a member of the GSMA.
 
Cellhire is a key supplier of bespoke and commercially competitive airtime to its Indirect channel partners, leveraging longstanding relationships with all three major UK networks (Vodafone, O2, EE) and over 40 key global MNOs. Atlas is an in-house developed billing engine and SIM management portal which creates an unrivalled customer experience. Leveraging international relationships with official sponsor mobile networks, Cellhire provides bespoke mobile voice & M2M data services to participants at major global sporting events such as the Olympics and FIFA World Cup.
 
The Company is committed to delivering the highest standards of customer service which is underlined by its continued attainment of ISO 9001, the internationally recognised quality standard. Cellhire is Investors in People certified and won the highly coveted Queen’s Award for International Enterprise, as a result of its success as a specialist in the delivery of mobile communication solutions for events around the world. Since 2019, Cellhire has attained ISO 27001, the internationally recognised Information Security Management System Standard (ISMS).
 
Cellhire recently secured a significant investment from mid-market private equity house LDC for a minority stake, to accelerate its substantial growth plans.

Name: CITC EuraRFID
Description:
The CITC-EuraRFID brings together the contactless technology skills and the existing experimentation platforms in the north of France and the Euro regions (Belgium, UK, Netherlands, Germany...) and is backed by over 250 members and partners. It is a centre for resources, experimentations and technical expertise in terms of identification, traceability, mobility and geolocation...
It supports the appropriation of contactless technologies (RFID, NFC, Zigbee and wireless sensor networks), the standardized and innovative solutions and the development of new activities with high potential.
Indeed, contactless technologies and wireless microsensor networks have been identified among the most important technologies for the 21st century and for the development of the Internet of Things, part of the Future Internet. 
In order to successfully leverage these innovation technologies and support the innovation within local economy, the CITC works on social acceptance (accessibility, consumer convenience, privacy...), networked RFID and future Internet of Things, health and environmental impact, and harmonization issues (interoperability between different systems harmonization of regional standards...).

Présent à Genève, Zurich, Paris, Londres et Luxembourg, Quaero Capital gère 2.6 milliards d'actifs (octobre 2024).

À l’heure où les réseaux FttH (et parfois les pseudo réseaux FttO) montrent cruellement leurs limites, où les attentes des entreprises sont fortes et où le cuivre tire peu à peu sa révérence, Prizz s’appuie sur son ADN technique pour prioriser la qualité et le haut niveau de performance de ses services de connectivité.

Prizz s’appuie ainsi sur un réseau en propre et sur un cœur de réseau de dernière génération de 100Gbps MPLS permettant de délivrer jusqu’à 10Gbps de bande passante. Parce que la qualité et la performance d’un réseau dépendent aussi de son déploiement, de ses raccordements et de la maîtrise de l’exploitation et de la maintenance, Prizz dispose de ses propres équipes, tant pour le génie civil que pour le déploiement optique, les raccordements, le système d’information, l’exploitation/maintenance et la vie du réseau. 

Prizz démontre ainsi que la qualité et la performance sont possibles, dans des conditions financières compétitives. Une approche qui fonctionne notamment grâce au soutien de ses actionnaires de référence, Quaero Capital et Générations.

A key concept of the LINCS is a physical co-localisation of researchers from the five partner institutions, creating a collaborative work space that facilitates exchange and innovation.

Information and communication technologies, systems and services are considered today as a key element in the evolution of the digital society. Description:
Achieving the European Union Green Deal objectives requires the development of efficient European railway transport for both passengers and freight. This will be reliant on the successful digitalisation of the European railway transport, for which the 5G FRMCS (Future Railways Mobile Communication System – the GSM-R successor) technology will be an enabler.

This 30-month H2020 EU-funded Project officially started on 1 November 2020. It consists of 8 Work Packages, which aim to validate the first FRMCS specifications by developing and testing prototypes for the FRMCS ecosystem for both trackside infrastructure and on-board use. 

UIC as 5GRAIL Project Coordinator will manage a consortium composed of UNIFE (representing the European rail supply industry), European Railways – DB Netz, SNCF Réseau, SBB, OBB and IP, European rail suppliers – Nokia, Kontron, Alstom, Thales, Siemens, CAF and Teleste – and Research Centres/Universities – IFSTTAR & Gustave Eiffel from France and DTU from Denmark.

Le Centrex IP est une technologie basée sur le transit des appels via un réseau MPLS. Ce type de standard téléphonique permet une parfaite convergence de vos outils de communication et de gestion (Fax to Mail, Mail to Fax, messagerie unifiée, réseau mutualisé Telecom / informatique, API s’intégrant dans vos messageries et logiciels de prospection...).

Cabinet de conseil fondé en 2010 par des professionnels du monde des télécoms associant compétences commerciales (négociation immobilière) et techniques (études et travaux d'infrastructures de réseau).

Apporter notre soutien en gestion de projets dans le cadre des investissements d'infrastructures de réseau télécom.

Une équipe expérimentée de vendeurs, négociateurs et experts techniques. 

Efficacité :
Une gestion transverse des aspects techniques et commerciaux. 

Transparence :  
Une information en temps réel sur les actions menées et un respect des délais. 

Le management clé en main des projets d’infrastructures des acteurs du monde des télécommunications. 
Filaire : création de réseaux fibre optique très haut débit (FTTH). Extension des réseaux. Densification des cœurs de réseau, création des points de présence (pop)..

Une double compétence technique et commerciale : 
Aspect vente/commercial : identifications des sites potentiels dans le cadre de l’accueil d’équipements d’infrastructure, obtentions des différentes autorisations, négociation avec les décideurs (élus, bailleurs, offices hlm, syndics, copropriétaires...).
Aspect technique : réalisation des études techniques, (APS/APD), évaluations financières, exécution des travaux (maîtrise d’ouvrage / d’œuvre), installation des équipements, visites techniques / mises en exploitation.

Name: V3D
Description:
EXPERT ON TELECOM DATA ANALYTICS

V3D is 100% owned by SoftAtHome, a software company for the digital home, providing software products for connectivity, pay TV, Home Networking and the Smart Home deployed with major operators in over 20 million homes in 18 countries.

Specialized in mobile and fixed network technologies, by collecting millions of data analytics, V3D product portfolio focuses on customer experience and carrier network service performance:

The EQUAL ONE solution enables MNOs to perceive the network service quality the way subscribers do when browsing the web, using an application or watching a video. Compared to traditional network Quality of Service (QoS) systems (probes and other network-centric metrics), collecting data directly from the subscriber’s device allows MNO’s to change their perspective from a network-centric view to a subscriber-centric view because performance KPIs collected on their smartphones reflect the real-life experience of their customers. These KPI’s give a 360° view of the carrier’s QoE and strongly contribute to monitor the network performance and the customer experience.

The MSCORE SOLUTION, a smart test server, provides real-time TCP/IP analysis during testing. mScore breaks down legacy barriers to QoS testing: available for both mobile and fixed-line broadband connection, from any mobile phone, web browser, set-top box or IoT equipment. mScore integrates seamlessly with existing test infrastructure for fast ROI, and its technology is easily scalable for large deployments.

By combining EQual One monitoring agents with the powerful investigation capabilities of mScore, you will benefit from an end-to-end investigation solution!

Are you experiencing unexpected, mysterious or malfunctioning behaviour in your services or networks?
Contact us to learn more about how you may benefit from V3D's investigation tools & solutions for your network!

Visit us at www.v3d.fr to find out more!

- une besoin de mobilité et d'accès à leur environnement de travail en France et à l'étranger.

Dans le cadre du plan de modernisation de la sécurité intérieure et plus particulièrement au sein du défi 4 - modernisation des systèmes d'information, il a été décidé de lancer le projet PC-STORM (Plate-Forme Convergée pour des Services à Très haut débit, Opérationnels, Résilients et Mobiles) pour redonner un avantage technique aux forces et fournir des services opérationnels à forte valeur ajoutée.

Ce projet s'appuie notamment sur la technologie LTE (long term evolution), désignée à terme pour remplacer les technologies PMR à bande étroite, pour laquelle :
- le ministère de l'intérieur s'est vu désigné le 23 octobre 2015 comme affectataire exclusif de bandes de fréquences dans le 700 Mhz.

Parfaitement opérationnel durant la Coupe du Monde de Rugby avec plus de 12000 utilisateurs quotidiens simultanées, les utilisateurs de la gendarmerie et police nationales ont rapidement adoptés ce système. 

Pour les Jeux Olympiques, Storm sera le moyen de communications principales de 120.000 agents. En sécurité publique, en maintien de l’ordre ou en police judiciaire, la capacité de communication haut débit, priorisée et inter opérée va permettre une souplesse et un efficacité dans les échanges radio.

Description:
Dispositifs d’alarme pour travailleurs isolés

PV sécurité, est une marque du groupe Présence Verte, leader en solutions de téléassistance aux personnes depuis plus de 30 ans.
Présence Verte soutient des personnes isolées ou en situation de fragilité à qui elle apporte sécurité et sérénité.
Son approche de l’autonomie, fondée sur la proximité, la solidarité et l’innovation , permet à tous ceux qui ont un besoin de soutien à domicile ou hors domicile, de disposer de services d’aide et d’écoute 24h/24 et 7j/7.

RÉGLEMENTATION
L’article L.4121 1 du code du travail impose à l’employeur d’assurer la protection de ses salariés.
En présence de travailleurs isolés , il a donc l’obligation de mettre en place des dispositifs adaptés pour permettre aux travailleurs concernés de signaler une situation de détresse et d’être secourus dans les meilleurs délais.

Travailleur isolé : quels sont les risques ?
Chute _ Problèmes médicaux _ Malaise _ Aléas climatiques _ Danger extérieur _ Agressions _ ...

Comment ça marche ?
- Situation à risque : déclenchement manuel ou automatique de l'alarme
- Prise en charge par le centre d'appels d'urgence : les opérateurs reçoivent et traitent les alarmes 24h/24 et 7j/7
Intervention : les opérateurs contactent les personnes habilitées ou les services d'urgence si la situation le nécessite

Les dispositifs d’alarme :

Le BPL (Broadband over Power Lines) ou Courant Porteur pro diffuse un accès haut débit au travers des prises de courant ou du circuit d'éclairage. Cette technologie performante facilite sensiblement la mise en réseau de points d'accès sans fil LiFi et/ou WiFi en évitant le tirage de câbles RJ45 ou de FO. 

Les industries (M2M, IoT), le Smart City, les établissements scolaires ou hospitaliers ainsi que les entreprises comptent parmi les secteurs où la demande de solutions de connectivité alternatives est en plus forte progression.

Avec à l'actif de son fondateur -Dominique Le Bourse- plusieurs centaines d'écoles et de nombreuses installations en environnement industriel et hospitalier ; PoE-Tic transmet son savoir-faire à ses partenaires. 

Agréés sous l’enseigne « PoE-T » ; ces installateurs, revendeurs et intégrateurs établis en France tirent parti de ces technologies alternatives innovantes en apportant de la valeur ajoutée à leurs propres offres pour conquérir et fidéliser une nouvelle clientèle : REJOIGNEZ-LES SANS ATTENDRE !

In February 2023, the Group presented its strategic plan « Lead the future », built on a new business model and guided by responsibility and efficiency. « Lead the future » capitalizes on network excellence to reinforce Orange's leadership in service quality.

Name: Colt Technology Services
Description:
Colt Technology Services (Colt) is a global digital infrastructure company which creates extraordinary connections to help businesses succeed. Powered by amazing people and like-minded partners, Colt is driven by its purpose: to put the power of the digital universe in the hands of its customers, wherever, whenever and however they choose.

Since 1992, Colt has set itself apart through its deep commitment to its customers, growing from its heritage in the City of London to a global business spanning 40+ countries, with over 6,000 employees and more than 80 offices around the world. Colt’s customers benefit from expansive digital infrastructure connecting 32,000 buildings across 230 cities, more than 50 Metropolitan Area Networks and 250+ Points of Presence across Europe, Asia, the Middle East, Africa and North America’s largest business hubs.

Privately owned, Colt is one of the most financially sound companies in the sector. Obsessed with delivering industry-leading customer experience, Colt is guided by its dedication to customer innovation, by its values and its responsibility to its customers, partners, people and the planet.

For more information, please visit www.colt.net

Name: SAGEMCOM
Description:
All over the world, thanks to the innovative solutions designed and built by its teams, Sagemcom provides, to the greatest number of people, access to broadband Internet, entertainment, and managed energy supply. As a “mission-driven company” since January 2022, Sagemcom makes sure that the design, construction and use of these solutions are sustainable, and fulfil the environmental and societal commitments known and shared by all its teams, partners and stakeholders. A technology leader in its markets, Sagemcom is 30% owned by its employees, has achieved over €2.4 billion turnover in 2025, and is profitable since it was founded.

Discover our "corporate purpose" and our commitments - https://www.sagemcom.com/en/commitments

"Joining Sagemcom group means being part of an international organization, where we have to take up new challenges every day in order to remain a leader in our markets. If teamwork, agility, creativity and new technologies attract you, then join the adventure! "

Go to our recruitment website https://www.sagemcom.com/career !

Name: Bouygues Telecom
Description:
Ce qui fait notre singularité ? 
Chez Bouygues Telecom, nous croyons que les relations humaines sont un besoin vital. La qualité de nos relations avec notre famille, nos amis, ceux qui nous entourent est déterminante pour notre bien-être, notre santé et même notre espérance de vie. Ce sont ces relations qui nous épanouissent, nous font aller de l’avant et nous permettent de vivre plus heureux, plus longtemps.

C’est pourquoi depuis notre création en 1996, les équipes Bouygues Telecom mettent toute leur énergie pour que la technologie soit avant tout au service de vos relations. Nous souhaitons agir pour faire grandir les relations humaines. En permettant à tous sans exception de garder le contact avec ses proches et la société. En devenant une source d’inspiration qui donne à chacun l’envie d’enrichir et d’améliorer la qualité de ses relations. 

Nos 10 500 collaborateurs relèvent tous ensemble au quotidien ce même défi : être engagés pour un numérique qui nous réunit.

 Nos métiers ? 
Quelles que soient vos aspirations il y aura forcément un métier pour vous chez Bouygues Telecom ! Plus de 150 métiers interagissent tous les jours : Télécom / Réseau, IT, Big Data, Innovation, Marketing, Commerce, Finance, Achats, Juridique... Nous avons besoin de tous les talents pour accomplir notre mission; car c’est cette richesse de profils et de compétences qui fait la qualité de nos services et contribue à la satisfaction de nos clients. 

Alors si...
Vous avez envie de mettre votre talent au service du développement numérique pour tous et de faire grandir les relations humaines : vous frappez à la bonne porte. 
Vous rêvez d’une entreprise qui donne le meilleur d’elle-même pour que vous puissiez donner le meilleur à votre tour : alors bienvenue !
 
#OnEstFaitPourEtreEnsemble

Name: inwi
Description:
inwi est le 3ème opérateur global de télécommunications au Maroc. Il opère sur les segments de la téléphonie fixe, internet et mobile. Ses offres sont destinées aussi bien à la clientèle grand public que celle des Entreprises. 

Lancé en février 2010, inwi a révolutionné les habitudes des Marocains en démocratisant les usages des télécommunications et en rendant les services accessibles à tous grâce à une approche simple, proche et audacieuse du marché des télécommunications.

L’opérateur emploie plus de 1223 collaborateurs et compte - à fin Décembre 2019- 10,7 millions de clients Mobile, soit 23,02% de parts de marché. inwi détient également 25,28% de parts de marché de l’Internet Global au Maroc ( ADSL, Internet Mobile, FTTH...) à la fin de la même période. 

inwi devient en 2019 le premier opérateur Telecom au Maroc à avoir obtenu l’agrément définitif de Bank Al Maghrib, via sa nouvelle filiale de paiement mobile en lançant son service Mobile Money. 
inwi a été sacré pour la 4ème année consécutive comme fournisseur de «l’accès internet mobile le plus performant durant l’année 2020 au Maroc» par nPerf, la plateforme de référence pour la mesure de la qualité de la connexion internet dans le monde.

Name: EXFO
Description:
EXFO develops smarter test, measurement and monitoring solutions for the global communications industry. We are trusted advisors to fixed and mobile network operators, hyperscalers and leaders in the manufacturing, development and research sector. They count on us to deliver superior visibility and insights into network performance, service reliability and user experience. Building on nearly 40 years of innovation, EXFO’s unique blend of equipment, software and services enable faster, more confident transformations related to 5G, cloud-native and fiber optic networks.

To find out more, visit www.EXFO.com and follow us on our blog - https://www.exfo.com/en/resources/blog/

Name: SFR
Description: SFR is the number one alternative telecoms operator in France. SFR is also an operator providing a comprehensive range of services meeting the expectations of private and business customers alike, offering them the best of the digital world. At year-end 2011, the total number of mobile customers was 21.5 million, and the active broadband residential customer base represented 5 million customers, which represent respectively a 31.3% and 22% market share.

Name: SES Satellites
Description: At SES, we believe that space has the power to make a difference. That’s why we design space solutions that help governments protect, businesses grow, and people stay connected—no matter where they are. With integrated multi-orbit satellites and our global terrestrial network, we deliver resilient, seamless connectivity and the highest quality video content to those shaping what’s next. Following our Intelsat acquisition, we now offer more than 100 years of combined global industry leadership—backed by a track record of bringing innovation “firsts” to market. As a trusted partner to customers and the global space ecosystem, SES is driving impact that goes far beyond coverage.

Name: Nokia Bell Labs
Description: Throughout our 100-year history, Nokia Bell Labs has overcome some of the world’s biggest scientific challenges by bringing together the brightest minds in mathematics, physics, computing and engineering. We identify a problem, and then commit our best people to find a solution. As Nokia’s industrial research lab, we innovate with purpose, pursuing responsible, sustainable technologies that will have a demonstrable impact on society. And we believe the best research is done in an inclusive, collaborative manner, taking multiple diverse points of view into account.

Name: Zayo Group
Description:
For more than 18 years, Zayo Group of companies has helped the world’s most ambitious organizations build the infrastructure behind what’s next. With one of the largest independent fiber networks, spanning 32 million fiber miles and 224,000 route miles across North America, Zayo powers the connectivity behind cloud, AI, media, financial markets, healthcare innovation, and global communications. As the digital economy accelerates, organizations need more than bandwidth. They need infrastructure that is secure, resilient, and built to support the demands of a data-driven world. Zayo combines deep fiber infrastructure with the expertise to design, deploy, and scale networks end-to-end helping organizations build the right architecture for whatever comes next. Behind that infrastructure is a team of engineers, operators, and problem-solvers who take pride in delivering the performance, reliability, and partnership our customers depend on every day. From blueprint to deployment, we help organizations move faster with confidence. 

Learn more at zayo.com.

Name: Eutelsat
Description:
Eutelsat is a global leader in satellite communications, delivering connectivity and broadcast services worldwide. It’s the first fully integrated GEO-LEO satellite operator with a fleet of 37 Geostationary satellites and a Low Orbit earth constellation of more than 600 satellites. 
Via our global fleet of satellites and associated ground infrastructure, we enable clients across Video, Data, Government, Fixed and Mobile Broadband markets to communicate effectively to their customers, irrespective of their location.
We are driven by the ambition to extend the benefits of digital services to users on land, at sea and in-flight.

Name: Free
Description:
Trublion historique des Télécoms, Free reste un opérateur pas comme les autres. Nous continuons de nous distinguer de nos concurrents par nos produits, par notre politique tarifaire ou encore par le ton employé avec nos abonnés.

Cette différence a aussi construit la grande entreprise que nous sommes devenus, qui réunit aujourd’hui plus de 11 500 collaborateurs. Elle a fait de nous un employeur... pas comme les autres.

Name: Airties
Description: Airties empowers operators to provide smooth, smart, secure connectivity. Airties turns smart connectivity into a competitive advantage for operators and enhances how subscribers experience connectivity in the real world: making every connection smarter and more reliable. Airties AI-driven insights enable operators to lower churn, reduce expenses, boost satisfaction, and attract new customers. Across departments, from engineering to marketing, Airties helps increase efficiency, accelerate innovation, and design smarter campaigns. Airties’ holistic suite of hardware-agnostic software enables ISPs to improve the connectivity experience, based on leading industry standards and open-source software, across their fibre, cable/DSL, and fixed wireless access (FWA) deployments. Airties’ customers include leading service providers such as AT&T, Cox, Deutsche Telekom, Telia, T-Mobile US, Vodafone, and many others across the world. More information is available at www.airties.com.

Name: NETIS Group
Description:
NETIS is an Panafricain leader in telecommunications and energy, operating across 17 countries on the continent.
With over 16 years of proven expertise, we design and deliver high-performance and sustainable network and energy solutions tailored to the specific needs of each market.
Our areas of specialization include energy systems, construction of telecom sites, deployment of fiber optic networks, and infrastructure maintenance.
As a trusted partner, we are committed to delivering exceptional performance, meeting deadlines, and upholding the highest standards of quality, safety, and operational excellence.

Name: Alcatel-Lucent Enterprise
Description:
Alcatel-Lucent Enterprise provides secure networking and communication solutions which enable organizations and industries to accelerate their operational efficiencies and competitiveness. In the Cloud. On Premises. Hybrid.

All solutions have built-in security, limited environmental impact and are fully compliant with data protection requirements of organizations and individuals at a national sovereignty and international industry level.

Alcatel-Lucent Enterprise focus on three pillars: Environment Sustainability, Social Responsibility, and Corporate Governance, providing technology solutions for the good of the environment, people, and business.

Over 100 years of innovation have made the company a trusted advisor to more than a million customers across the world.

With headquarters in France and 3,400 business partners worldwide, Alcatel-Lucent Enterprise achieves an effective global reach with a local focus.
__

The Alcatel-Lucent name and logo are trademarks of Nokia used under license by ALE.

Name: Camusat
Description:
Camusat is one of the market leaders in the implementation of telecom infrastructures and one of the most experienced network developers.

OUR MISSION: In an extremely dynamic technological environment, we help telecom actors to efficiently build and optimize their networks development by integrating traditional telecom technologies with the most innovative know-how from adjoining fields. Our mission goes beyond the technological field: we are also committed to promoting our employees' safety & well-being; reducing our environmental impact and investing in development & recognition within Camusat host communities.

OUR VISION: We became a key partner for our customers through our expertise in the development of fix & mobile networks. Our leadership is undisputed today. Building partnerships is the key principle that guides us and it's the only approach in establishing and developing long-term business relationships. Continuous R&D in innovative solutions, integration of quality-proofed technologies & services, proficient project management skills & flexibility to adapt are the key assets which differentiate and define Camusat as a highly competitive reference on the market.

OUR BUSINESS LINES: Thanks to our experience & know-how of the whole telecom development process, we are a constant companion to our customers. 

OUR PEOPLE: Diversity is the key to success. Nothing would be possible without diversity of know-hows, cultures and individual richness of our 2,750 employees. Diversity combined with motivating incentive plans, strong team spirit, training & international mobility are our strengths in achieving our client’s high standard requirements. 

YOU CAN FIND OUR JOB OFFERS ON OUR WEBSITE WWW.CAMUSAT.COM AND CONTACT US AT CONTACT@CAMUSAT.COM FOR FUTHER INFORMATION

Name: iBASIS
Description:
iBASIS is the independent force driving transformation in global communications. iBASIS drives innovative models, pragmatic execution, proactive strategies, and deep industry relationships that help manage the complexities in voice, messaging, mobile, and IoT businesses.

iBASIS sets global connectivity, quality, and security standards—delivering critical value and returns across voice, SMS A2P messaging, RCS, mobile data, 5G roaming, and IoT. Trusted by operators and digital players worldwide, iBASIS has been at the forefront of innovation for 30 years, empowering customers with the formula to compete—with Performance, Profitability, and Protection. iBASIS serves 1,000+ customers across 28 locations worldwide.

Name: Axione
Description:
En s’imposant comme leader sur le marché des Réseaux d’Initiative Publique, Axione accompagne les collectivités dans la mise en oeuvre de leur politique d’aménagement numérique du territoire.

Axione, détenue par Bouygues Energies & Services et Mirova, est un acteur global du secteur des infrastructures de télécommunications au service des collectivités territoriales, des opérateurs et des équipementiers et s’organise autour de trois pôles d’activités :
• La conception, le déploiement et la maintenance de réseaux fixes et mobiles,
• L’exploitation de réseaux filaires et radios,
• Le financement et la gestion d’actifs d’infrastructures de télécommunications haut et très haut débit.

Fort de son expertise en zones rurales, Axione crée en 2018 CityFast, opérateur d’infrastructures dédié à la Zone Très Dense. À terme cette infrastructure couvrira, en propre, plus de 3,4 millions de foyers.

Parallèlement, Axione apporte son expertise multi-technologique aux Grands Comptes publics et privés pour leurs proposer des solutions innovantes (Couverture Radio Indoor, réseaux privés fibre et radio, Smart Territoires, etc.).

Name: Spirent Communications
Description:
Spirent is now Keysight, delivering industry-leading solutions in Positioning, Test Automation, and Assurance Solutions.

We provide innovative products, services, and managed solutions that address the test, assurance, and automation challenges of a new generation of technologies, including 5G, 6G, cloud, autonomous vehicles, and beyond. From testing in the lab to testing in the real world, Spirent helps companies deliver on their promise to their customers of a new generation of connected devices and technologies.

Keysight is its people. When you join the Keysight team, you will join forces and work alongside some of the industry’s most passionate subject matter experts. In an environment of innovation, you will find a place where you can grow, think, explore, create, and make change happen.

Name: TRANSATEL (an NTT company)
Description:
At Transatel, we imagine innovative cellular connectivity solutions and deploy them for prestigious clients like Airbus, BMW, Air France and Worldline. As a leading Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) enabler and global IoT connectivity pioneers, our SIM cards connect millions of vehicles, industrial and consumer devices to public and private cellular networks across the world. Transatel also provides global cellular data connectivity for international travelers and distributed workforce through its Ubigi eSIM solution.

Our diverse organization gathers 250+ telecom and IT experts from 40 nationalities working together in our new Paris La Défense headquarter (France). We offer inspiring professional and personal growth opportunities for talents with all backgrounds and experience. If you are looking for an exciting career move and new challenges in a fast-growing business environment, welcome at Transatel! Join our team now, and become part of the extended NTT group, one of the largest and most innovative technology company in the world. With its global footprint and 330,000 employees worldwide, NTT has been pushing innovation forward for more than 150 years.

Name: Sogetrel
Description:
En première ligne de la transformation numérique des entreprises et des territoires, le Groupe Sogetrel est spécialisé dans les services aux infrastructures numériques et équipements connectés. Il contribue à la qualité de vie des citoyens, à la performance des entreprises et à la durabilité des territoires au travers de 3 grandes missions : 

 CONNECTER : construction de réseaux de communication fixes et mobiles.

 INTÉGRER : intégration de solutions connectées (smart city, smart building, bornes interactives, vidéoprotection, IoT...).

 EXPLOITER : services d’installation, de support et de maintenance des réseaux et des solutions numériques des entreprises (interventions sur site, help desk, infogérance ...).

Name: Covage
Description:
Covage is the 3rd largest infrastructure operator in France dedicated to the business market. It is the only wholesale operator with the capacity to offer a complete range of fibre and 5G solutions, exclusively dedicated to the business market. More than 200 operators rely on its networks to provide very high-speed connectivity solutions to businesses and government sites. The Covage network addresses 150,000 end customers and covers 70% of French businesses with dedicated fibre (FTTO) and 75% with shared fibre (FTTH Pro) and a 4G/5G mobile offering.
With a multi-year investment plan of €150 million to open up new areas, Covage intends to make 100% of businesses eligible by the end of 2024. As a national operator, Covage relies on 360 employees and more than 20 agencies to provide a local service.

Name: IPC Systems
Description:
With over 7,000 customers around the globe, we leverage more than 50 years of experience in delivering award-winning SaaS communications platforms and ultra-low electronic trading connectivity. 

Our accumulated expertise across regulations, market structures, asset classes and technologies gives our clients real choice. We strive to understand clients’ challenges to deliver first-rate products, services and support—today and for the future.

Name: SFR Business
Description:
SFR Group is the second largest telecoms operator in France with a turnover of 11 billion euros in 2015 and prime positions in all market segments, from consumer, to Business to Business (B2B), local authorities, and wholesale. Equipped with the leading fibre optic network (FTTB/FTTH) with more than 10 millions eligible connections, SFR also provides 3G coverage for more than 99% of the population and 4G/4G+ coverage for 81%. With regard to the Consumer segment, the Group operates under the SFR and RED by SFR brands.

In the B2B segment, Altice Group is present in 6 countries, with strong position brands :
•	France with SFR Business
•	Portugal with PT Empressas
•	USA with Suddenlink / Cablevision
•	Israel with Hot
•	Suisse with Green
•	Dominican Republic with Altice Domenicana

In France, SFR Business leads its transformation, starting from a traditionanl telco provider to a global provider of enterprise digital solutions. 
Companies have to adapt to profound mutations in their mode of operation, like acceleration of products cycles, or digitalization of information . Those major changes drive SFR Business strategy.

Therefore, SFR Business not only provides connectivity, but especially provides innovating services that support the growth and the digital transformation of companies. With its 100% fully-owned fiber network delivers high-performance fixed and mobile connectivity , SFR Business offers ICT solutions to all enterprises, from SMEs to global company and public administrations : Unified Communication, IoT, Cloud, Security, Customer Relationship Services, and Managed Networks.

Name: Vantiva
Description:
Vantiva (Euronext Paris: VANTI) is a global technology leader in connectivity technologies. For over 130 years, we have delivered solutions that connect what matters most. Today, we continue to redefine connectivity with industry-leading broadband, video, and IoT-driven smart systems that elevate how people live, work, and connect globally. 
Vantiva combines a customer-focused approach with decades of software development, electronics hardware design, and supply chain expertise to deliver high-quality solutions at scale. This proficiency has positioned us as a trusted provider to leading network service providers, enterprise customers, and consumers around the world. 
Our strong commitment to sustainability and responsible business practices has earned us multiple Gold and Platinum Medals from EcoVadis for environmental and social performance. These awards place us among the top 2% of organizations in our category evaluated globally. 
With our headquarters in Paris and major offices in Australia, Brazil, China, India, South Korea, the United Kingdom, Portugal, and the United States, we serve a diverse global customer base. The acquisition of CommScope’s Home Networks business in January 2024 further bolstered our ongoing commitment to innovation.

Name: Bouygues Telecom Business
Description:
Notre métier ? Vous proposer des solutions adaptées à votre activité : Téléphonie Fixe et Mobile, Internet et Réseaux, Services et prestations.

Depuis 1997, Bouygues Telecom Entreprises s’engage à vous proposer des solutions de communications conçues pour vous permettre d’avancer et de vous concentrer sur l’essentiel : votre activité.
Chaque jour, nos équipes d’experts vous accompagnent pour mettre le meilleur de la technologie au service du développement de votre entreprise.

Bouygues Telecom Entreprises conçoit toutes ses solutions et services avec la même exigence : permettre à ses clients de communiquer plus librement, où qu’ils se trouvent et quel que soit leur outil de travail.

Bouygues Telecom Entreprises c’est : 

-	2 millions de professionnels et d’entreprises
-	900 collaborateurs dédiés aux clients entreprises
-	70 distributeurs et intégrateurs accrédités partout en France

Name: China Telecom Europe
Description:
Looking to grow your business in China-APAC or establish a presence? China Telecom Europe (CTE) can help you. CTE is a wholly-owned subsidiary of China Telecom Global (CTG), the international arm of China Telecom.
 
We can integrate all your international communications needs under one global contract. We call it the Digital Silk Road. Let us handle your data, voice, cloud, hosting and ICT requirements; and give you the peace of mind that comes from knowing you're in the safe hands of industry experts with local knowledge.
 
CTE is the leading provider of international telecommunication and ICT services. We serve European multinational enterprises, Chinese-APAC enterprises in Europe, carriers, telecom service providers and Europe-based Chinese consumers.
 
We have an extensive global network providing services than span the world. We offer you more options than any other carrier when you do business with China-APAC.
 
Our European-Asia Network consists of more terrestrial and submarine routes than any of our competitors. Domestically, we are the owner/operator of the largest digital network in China. This results in superior lower latency, greater diversity and improved resilience when accessing business applications to and from China.
 
Best of all, you can get all the services you want from one provider. CTE seamlessly connects your global business to the world’s fastest growing markets in China-APAC region.

Name: Harmonic
Description: Harmonic (NASDAQ: HLIT), the worldwide leader in virtualized broadband solutions, is transforming multi-gigabit connectivity. The company’s industry-leading cOSTM virtualized broadband platform, suite of solutions for fiber and DOCSIS, and a growing portfolio of AI-powered network intelligence solutions, enable broadband service providers to simplify operations, deliver exceptional subscriber experiences and expand revenue streams. With thousands of vCMTS servers and hundreds of thousands of RPDs deployed globally, Harmonic powers next-generation broadband services with five-nines reliability. Anchored with a customer-first approach and driven by a legacy of innovation, Harmonic supports broadband service providers at every stage of their network evolution. More information is available at www.harmonicinc.com.

Name: TDF
Description: Working at the very heart of the digital revolution, TDF is developing a multi-format and multi-support terrestrial platform for managing and distributing audio, video and data content to all types of receivers. As a dedicated broadcaster and designer of telecom networks, TDF is positioned at the nexus of the new digital, mobile and multimedia technologies by using all means of transmission:  terrestrial, IP, satellite, etc. For years, TDF has been creating innovative solutions, to the point it is now developing tomorrow’s communications, channels such as digital cinema, 3D,  connected DTT, video on-demand, catch-up television, digital radio, web broadcasting, real-time traffic display and ultra-high speed telecom networks.  The singular goal here is to provide our customers and end users with media whenever, wherever, and however they wish...

Name: Connect44
Description:
The Only Telecoms Service Provider You Need 

As one of Europe’s largest independent, vendor-agnostic, fixed & mobile services and solutions providers, we offer a comprehensive network planning, build and management solutions portfolio. 

The Connect44 Group of companies was founded in 2000 in Luzern, Switzerland, by James Rogerson and Leo Kidel. 

The company was established as a telecommunications consulting agency and has strategically evolved into one of Europe’s largest independent managed services companies with more than 1,300 telecom experts in 12 European markets, plus Malaysia as a Delivery Operations centre, serving fibre network operators, TowerCos, mobile network and fixed network telecom operators.

We value client relationships, built on trust and integrity; we are committed to providing agile and lean solutions that achieve excellent results. As the industry evolves, we offer a complete end-to-end solutions portfolio, including network planning, building, and management for network operators, fibre companies, and telecoms Site Providers.

Name: Group Vivendi Africa
Description: GVA c'est 2.000 expertes et experts dédiés à la construction, au développement et à la commercialisation de l’accès Internet Très Haut Débit en Afrique depuis 2017 via l'exploitation d'un réseau en fibre optique en propre, sous la marque CANALBOX. GVA est présent dans 15 métropoles réparties sur 10 pays !

Name: AudioCodes
Description:
AudioCodes Ltd. (NASDAQ, TASE: AUDC) is a global leader in enterprise voice technology and voice AI innovation.

We help organizations unlock the full value of voice, transforming every conversation into a strategic asset that drives smarter decisions, better experiences and business growth.

Our portfolio spans secure voice infrastructure, unified communications and contact center integration and next-generation AI-powered voice solutions. 

With over 30 years of expertise and a presence in more than 100 countries, AudioCodes is trusted by 65 of the Fortune 100 to power intelligent, agile and future-ready interactions across the enterprise.

Name: Sigfox 0G technology
Description:
Sigfox 0G (Zero-G) technology is a Low-Power Wide-Area (LPWAN) IoT networking protocol dedicated to Massive IoT. It is designed to connect devices at a low-cost, ultra energy-efficient and secure manner.

Sigfox 0G technology is owned by UnaBiz, a proven global Massive IoT service provider, and has been adopted by 70+ national 0G Operators as a global standard. Together, UnaBiz and the 0G Operators provide the Global 0G Network that connects over 10 million sensors for 1500 B2B customers worldwide to power sustainable business growth.

Name: Italtel
Description:
We help our customers to choose the most suitable solutions for the characteristics of their business, to develop the traditional communication technologies they already have in the field, in order to integrate them with new technologies according to hybrid-cloud and cybersecurity logic. 

We do that thanks to our robust ability for system integration with multi-technology application, on products and technologies developed by us or by third parties. We support customers, Telco Service Providers or large public and private companies, over time with our managed services. Creating value for customers is our leading star, and our 1,500 professionals are strongly committed to this.

Our core business focuses on the design, development and deployment of communications networks and on the provision of collaborative solutions created by integrating state-of-the-art technologies.

We pursue our commitment to achieve business objectives in a sustainable and inclusive way, with full respect for people’s rights, fair competition, environmental protection, occupational health and safety. We consider sustainability to be fundamental and, through our activities, we are committed to a more planet-friendly society.

Since June 2024, our shareholders have been Nextalia SGR SpA (71.38%) and Clessidra Capital Credit SGR SpA (28.62%)

By publicly uploading a comment or photograph, you give Italtel permission to feature your content. This will always be credited.

Name: GCX
Description: GCX offers network services which power digital transformation for enterprises, new media providers, and telecoms carriers. We cover all aspects of cloud-centric connectivity from managed SD-WAN and hybrid networks, to direct Cloud connections and 100 Gbps+ waves. With a pedigree going back 30+ years, GCX are experts in providing connectivity throughout the Emerging Markets Corridor into Asia via the vast GCX subsea network (the world’s largest private submarine cable network), with extensions available in more than 200 countries worldwide.

Name: LINK Mobility
Description:
LINK Mobility Group AS is a CPaaS provider headquarted in Oslo, Norway. We are one of Europe's leading providers within mobile communications, specializing in mobile messaging services and mobile solutions.

We offer a wide range of scalable services and solutions across industries and sectors due to a growing demand for digital convergence between businesses and customers, platforms, and users. The Group is headquartered in Oslo, Norway, and is publicly listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange.

We continue to experience strong organic growth with a high degree of recurring revenue as customers tend to move more business activities onto the mobile platforms.

Name: Transaction Network Services (TNS)
Description:
TNS is a global provider of Infrastructure-as-a-Service (IaaS) solutions to the financial, communications and payments markets. Established more than 30 years ago, its extensive portfolio of innovative, value-added services supports thousands of organizations across more than 60 countries to interact efficiently, conducting mission critical processes securely and adopt new technologies flexibly. TNS’ state-of-the-art, scalable, and secure communications solutions make TNS a leader in an increasingly connected world.

In 2021 TNS became a wholly owned subsidiary of Koch Equity Development LLC, the investment and acquisition arm of Koch Industries. For more information, please visit tnsi.com

Name: RAD
Description: RAD delivers best-of-breed edge, xHaul and Industrial IoT solutions for communications service providers and critical infrastructure operators. Drawing on over 40 years of innovation and expertise, RAD works closely with customers to design market-leading solutions that simplify operations, help users derive more value from their networks and ensure always-on reliability. Whether for business services 5G fixed wireless access, Private 5G (campus-based edge cloud) for IoT services, or O-RAN xHaul, RAD supports customers through the entire project lifecycle, from design to deployment. Founded in 1981, RAD serves as the anchor of the $1.6 billion RAD Group.

Name: Free Pro
Description:
Free Pro, le meilleur de Free pour les entreprises !

Bienvenue chez Free Pro, la filiale B2B du Groupe iliad. 

Innovation, prix, liberté, service client, infrastructures, Free Pro répond aux besoins télécoms, cybersécurité, IT et cloud de toutes les entreprises, de la TPE au grand groupe, de la PME aux organisations publiques. 

En proposant des Offres PRO fixes et mobiles simples et ultraperformantes et des Solutions XPR spécifiques, qui répondent aux enjeux plus complexes des entreprises et organisations de plus de 100 salariés, Free Pro s’adresse ainsi à l’ensemble du marché entreprises. 

Expert de la connectivité et de la donnée depuis plus de vingt-cinq ans, Free Pro gère toute la chaîne de valeur des données des organisations, de leur collecte à leur transport et de leur sécurisation à leur hébergement. Il garantit leur disponibilité, leur accessibilité et leur intégrité à tout moment.
 
Et parce que chez Free, c’est le client d’abord, l’humain avant tout, Free Pro garantit un service de proximité, partout en France, pour être au plus près des besoins des entreprises et nouer avec elles une véritable relation de confiance.

Name: Alcatel mobile
Description:
Mobile innovation that creates and enhances moments of joy everyday, for everyone.
This is our positioning, our philosophy and the key message of our brand. It is what we deliver that no other brand in the category does and it informs everything we do and say.
 
Of course, it’s impossible to define joy as any one thing – that takes the fun out of it. Joy is about discovery and experimentation, moments big and small. It can be anything from a single instant to a life-defining experience; a rush of emotion or a huge event. Our products create, amplify and share those moments – whatever they may be.
 
Spontaneous and ever-changing, ‘now’ is the instant where all of this joy occurs. It’s every moment of life, every burst of laughter and every flash of wonder. It’s where we explore and engage with each other and the world around us.
 
So always, enjoy.now

Name: Orange Marine
Description:
Orange Marine, a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Orange Group, is a cable ship owner specialized in offshore work on submarine cables, from designing and engineering new projects to installing new connections and maintaining existing cables (telecommunications, energy, or hybrid).

Orange Marine can operate worldwide and for any type of customer: telecom operators, cable manufacturers, GAMAM, offshore wind farm operators, etc. 

Its expertise is internationally recognized, allowing it to occupy an important place in the world at a time when submarine cables, which are becoming more and more efficient, are of strategic importance for the world economy and are being deployed in every sea and ocean.

With its Italian sister company, Elettra Tlc, Orange Marine has a fleet of 6 cable ships and 1 survey ship, representing almost 15% of the submarine installation and maintenance market.

At the end of 2024, Orange Marine's ships had installed over 288,000 kilometers of fiber optic submarine cables and had carried out over 1,200 repairs, some at depths of over 6,000 meters.

In addition, Orange Marine designs, builds, and operates a full range of submarine machinery for work on submarine cables (ROV - Remotely Operated Vehicles, plows, trenchers, crawlers) capable of working on any type of cable.

In 2023, a new cable ship, the Sophie Germain, joins the Orange Marine fleet. 

 More information at marine.orange.com

Name: Wifirst
Description: Wifirst is the European leader in professional WiFi infrastructure, delivered in an “as a service” model. The company designs, deploys, and operates high-performance, secure, and sustainable connectivity solutions, relieving IT teams in businesses and public organizations so they can focus on their core activities. With over 20 years of expertise and R&D, Wifirst is the strategic partner of major organizations (Les Mousquetaires, Accor, The Ascott, the Ministry of the Armed Forces, Norauto, Barrière, etc.) in modernizing their infrastructures. Operating today 420,000 WiFi access points in more than 30 countries, the Wifirst Group continues to strengthen its leadership in Europe, particularly in the United Kingdom, Spain, Italy, the Netherlands, and Germany.

Name: Televes
Description:
Televes is a technology company that designs, develops and manufactures solutions for telecommunications and industrial LED lighting infrastructures deployed in homes,, buildings and cities, so that users can enjoy the most advanced leisure, communication, health and wellness services. Headquartered in Santiago de Compostela (Spain), the company was founded in 1958. Today, it is the head of a corporation with more than 20 industrial and service firms, more than 800 employees worldwide and 75 invention patents. Televes has 11 international subsidiaries and delivers its products to more than 100 countries on five continents, through an extensive network of distributors.

Televes is constantly evolving, aligned with the criteria of the European Digital Agenda. As as a specialist in television and data distribution networks, it develops complementary business lines in the fields of professional LED lighting, audiovisual network solutions for the Hospitality sector and eHealth technologies for the healthcare sector.

Name: ETSI
Description:
ETSI provides platforms where interested parties come together & collaborate on the development & promotion of standards for Information & Communication Technology (ICT) systems and services, used globally for the benefit of all.

ETSI provides members with an open and inclusive environment to support the timely development, ratification and testing of globally applicable standards for ICT-enabled systems, applications and services across all sectors of industry and society.

We are at the forefront of new Information and Communication Technologies, leading the development of standards that enable a sustainable and securely connected society.

We are a not-for-profit body with more than 900 member organizations worldwide, drawn from over 60 countries and five continents. Members comprise a diversified pool of large and small private companies, research entities, academia, government and public organizations.

ETSI is one of only three bodies officially recognized by the EU as a European Standards Organization (ESO).

ETSI, 650 Route des Lucioles, 06921 Sophia Antipolis Cedex - France

Name: Tait Communications
Description:
Our clients protect communities, power cities, move citizens, harness resources and save lives all over the world. We work with them to create, support and unify the critical communication solutions they depend on to do their jobs.   

Digital wireless communication forms the central nervous system of everything we do. Around this resilient, robust core we design, develop, manufacture, test, deploy, support and manage innovative communication environments for organizations that have to put their total trust in the systems and people they work with.   

We’ve worked hard to develop genuine insight into our clients’ worlds, and have pursued engineering, operational and services excellence for more than 50 years. This understanding, and our belief in championing open-standards technology, means we can give our clients the best possible choice and value to achieve the human outcomes they’re driven by.   

We’re not simply aligned with our clients; we’re devoted to their cause.   

Tait Communications’ sole dividend receiving shareholder is a charitable trust which shares the company’s operating profits across several donation and investment streams responsible for research and development, regional reinvestment and education.

Name: Ateme
Description:
If you have ever watched television or enjoyed a movie on your phone or tablet, this experience was likely brought to you through an Ateme solution created by our award-engineering teams 

Ateme (PARIS: ATEME) is the global leader in video delivery, partnering with top content and service providers, and streaming platforms. Through our cutting-edge R&D and innovation, we enable clients to deliver high-quality video experiences on any device, boosting engagement and revenue.

Name: La Poste Mobile
Description:
La Poste Mobile est devenue en seulement 10 ans le 1er opérateur virtuel de Télécommunications en France. La Poste Mobile, c’est : 
· Une marque engagée pour le pouvoir d’achat avec des forfaits parmi les moins chers du marché et des mobiles à 1€ avec la souscription de forfaits éligibles avec engagement, facilitant ainsi l’accès aux technologies au plus grand nombre.

- Une marque engagée pour un numérique plus responsable avec des actions de sensibilisation auprès des jeunes et des services dédiés aux seniors.

Name: 3GPP
Description:
The 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) unites [Seven] telecommunications standard development organizations (ARIB, ATIS, CCSA, ETSI, TSDSI, TTA, TTC), known as “Organizational Partners” and provides their members with a stable environment to produce the Reports and Specifications that define 3GPP technologies.

3GPP specifications and studies are contribution-driven, by member companies, in Working Groups and at the Technical Specification Group level.

The three Technical Specification Groups (TSG) in 3GPP are;

- Radio Access Networks (RAN),
- Services & Systems Aspects (SA),
- Core Network & Terminals (CT) 

The Working Groups, within the TSGs, meet regularly and come together for their quarterly TSG Plenary meeting, where their work is presented for information, discussion and approval.

Each TSG has a particular area of responsibility for the Reports and Specifications within its own Terms of Reference (Details available in the Specification Groups pages at www.3gpp.org).

Name: American Tower Europe
Description:
Through a global portfolio of digital infrastructure assets and other communications real estate solutions, American Tower enables our partners and customers to keep people and communities connected in a responsible, equitable and sustainable way.

With the increasing popularity of mobile data services and emerging technologies like 5G, edge and cloud computing, our collaborative teams tailor, expand and innovate solutions to meet current and future connectivity needs.

Since 2012, we have been an active stakeholder in the European telecommunications market and we currently operate over 30,000 sites across France, Germany and Spain.

Join us to build a more connected world.

Name: ASN
Description:
Alcatel Submarine Networks, leads the industry in terms of transmission capacity and installed base with more than 850,000 km of optical submarine systems deployed worldwide (enough to circumnavigate the globe 21 times!)
From traditional telecom applications to infrastructure for content and “Over The Top” service providers, as well as solutions for offshore oil and gas applications, ASN provides all elements of turnkey global undersea transmission systems, tailored to individual customer’s needs. 
An extensive service portfolio completes its comprehensive offering for the submarine business, including project management, installation and commissioning, along with marine and maintenance operations performed by ASN’s fully owned fleet of cable ships.

Name: CROSSCALL
Description:
Crosscall, créateur de la téléphonie mobile durable, propose des mobiles et smartphones étanches, résistants et dotés d’une grande autonomie. 

L’entreprise a été créée en 2009 par Cyril Vidal pour répondre à des usages et des besoins spécifiques auxquels il était lui-même confronté et pour lesquels aucun matériel spécifique n’existait.

Name: Hub One
Description:
Hub One est un groupe de sociétés de technologies, filiales du groupe Aéroports de Paris qui accompagne les PME, grandes entreprises et sites à forte fréquentation tels que les aéroports, les gares, les chaînes logistiques et les centres commerciaux dans leurs projets d’évolution numérique.

Name: XpFibre
Description:
A propos du groupe XpFibre
XpFibre est un Opérateur d’Infrastructure spécialisé dans la conception, la construction et l'exploitation de réseaux de fibre optique. Name: Airbus Public Safety and Security
Description:
At Public Safety and Security, part of Airbus Defence and Space, we deliver the future of critical collaboration to connect the many people working to protect us every day.

Our customers and end users are governments and private organisations in sectors including public safety, defence, transportation, utilities, healthcare, and event security. We support their digital transformation by offering the latest in integrated, secure and cyber-resilient mission- and business-critical communication and collaboration solutions with professional services.

From EPOS systems in retail stores, to behaviour monitoring in vehicles and off-grid solar power in remote rural regions of East Africa. We have expertise across multiple sectors and use cases, including agriculture, healthcare, security, transport, utilities and building management. Name: Passman

Cellnex Telecom est le premier opérateur européen d’infrastructures de télécommunications. Groupe espagnol basé et coté en bourse à Barcelone (2 700 salariés, 4 Mds€ de chiffre d’affaires), il est présent dans 10 pays européens.

Name: Fédération Française des Télécoms
Description:
La Fédération Française des Télécoms réunit les associations et opérateurs  de communications électroniques en France.

Née à la fin 2007, elle a pour mission de promouvoir une industrie responsable et innovante au regard de la société, de l’environnement, des personnes et des entreprises, de défendre les intérêts économiques du secteur et  de valoriser l’image de ses membres et de la profession au niveau national et international. Pour cela, la Fédération propose un dialogue structuré, ouvert, constructif et permanent avec l’ensemble des parties prenantes du secteur : les consommateurs, les pouvoirs publics, les partenaires professionnels et institutionnels... 
Elle privilégie chaque fois que possible la régulation ouverte.

La Fédération est structurée autour de six commissions : Consommation, Contenus, Développement durable, Normalisation, Sécurité et Emploi / Fiscalité, et d’un Collège Mobile.

Les membres fondateurs de la Fédération : AFORS Telecom, France Telecom, Bouygues Telecom, SFR, Colt
Les membres adhérents : Auchant telecom, Blancheporte mobile, Bouygues Telecom, CIC Mobile, Cofidis mobile, Colt Telecom, Crédit Mutuel Mobile, La Poste mobile, Legos, M6 Mobile, Naxos, NRJ Mobile, Numéricable-SFR, Orange, Prosodie, Verizon, Worldline

Description: Forte de ses 1 200 collaborateurs et de son bureau d’études intégré, ERT Technologies, est une filiale de SFR Group et représente les activités d’Altice Technical Services en France. Notre maillage territorial est une force qui nous permet de satisfaire notre client opérateur et les collectivités locales et grands comptes du secteur public ou privé.

Name: ENSIO

ENSIO est le spécialiste des déploiements des réseaux numériques et d’énergie. Name: Agence nationale des fréquences (ANFR)
Description:
L’Agence nationale des fréquences, établissement public administratif, a été créée par la loi de réglementation des télécommunications du 26 juillet 1996 avec pour mission d'assurer la planification, la gestion et le contrôle de l'utilisation du domaine public des fréquences radioélectriques en France. Le 1er janvier 1997, l’ANFR voit le jour avec le rapprochement du comité de coordination des télécommunications (CCT), le service national des radiocommunications (SNR) et une partie de la direction générale des postes et des télécommunications.

L’ANFR est un établissement public gérant l’ensemble des fréquences radioélectriques en France. Celles-ci sont utilisées pour toutes les communications sans fil, des secteurs entiers de l’économie en dépendent : communications mobiles, transports, internet des objets, télévision, défense nationale, industrie... Les services et équipements utilisant des fréquences sont de plus en plus nombreux et en perpétuelle évolution, ce qui implique pour l’Agence d’anticiper ces évolutions pour garantir à tous l’accès à cette ressource non extensible.

L’ANFR est l’interlocutrice des grands utilisateurs du spectre des fréquences. Elle délivre les accords pour les implantations de sites  radioélectriques en s’assurant de la compatibilité électromagnétique. Depuis 2020, elle suit de près le déploiement de la 5G sur le territoire français. Tous les sites radioélectriques sont d’ailleurs recensés sur le site Cartoradio.fr afin de permettre à tous de suivre le déploiement des réseaux.

L’action de l’ANFR auprès du grand public est primordiale. Elle surveille l’exposition du public aux ondes et veille au respect des valeurs limites qui garantissent l’absence d’effets sur la santé, assure également de la conformité des équipements radios et des terminaux disponibles sur le marché en procédant à des mesures de débit d’absorption spécifique (DAS) et veille à la protection de la réception de la TNT et traite les réclamations des des téléspectateurs.

Elle tient son origine de la société CSTEL, fondée en 2007 par Gilles DESPEYROUX et Fabrice REQUENA. En 2019, au départ de Monsieur DESPEYROUX et encouragé par le souhait commun de se développer en prenant part à chaque décision stratégique, les salariés deviennent actionnaires. Stéphane BOURRON, Jean-Pierre AVEZAC et David GAYRAL prennent part à l’aventure avec Fabrice REQUENA à leur tête en tant qu’actionnaire majoritaire. C’est en 2021 que, convaincus par la nécessité d’avoir une image qui leur ressemble, CSTEL devient INELINK.

INELINK représente la détermination, l’assertivité, la passion d’un métier partagée par une équipe autant atypique que soudée. Des piliers bien maîtrisés qui leur permettent de répondre à des projets ambitieux de manière objectivement nouvelle, améliorée et toujours avec brio ! !

Name: CHASER - Channel Charting as a Service
Description:
CHASER is a collaborative research project funded by the CHIST-ERA programme of the European Union and dedicated to bringing unsupervised machine learning to wireless communication systems. We pioneer channel charting - the application of dimensionality reduction to propagation data - to future radio access networks. This approach enables a wide range of location-based services without resorting to the spectrally costly and invasive traditional positioning methods.

The objective of CHASER is to develop methods and algorithms allowing to implement online, real time, network-wide channel charting, and to develop its predictive capabilities in real-world use cases. Ultimately, we envision channel charting as a service (CaaS), which assists a number of network functions and user-level applications with a pseudo-location management architecture accessible through a dedicated application programming interface.

The consortium involves Aalto University (Finland), Inria (France), ETH Zürich (Switzerland) and the University of Minho (Portugal).

Description:

As a result of the challenges to the Voice business posed by OTT services and the ever decreasing low entry level to voice trading, the amount of fraud has dramatically increased over the last few years. Nextocell brings a new tool to carrier risk management with financial protection against damaging disputes that allows carriers to avoid losing time and money in dispute management as well as avoiding the cost of taking out credit insurance policies.

With multiple geographical groups forming common billing islands (e.g. EU, ONA) CLI corruption has become widespread, heavily impacting operators' revenue models. Sophisticated manipulation of the original CLI and PAI with false but real attributed local identification has become a mainstream activity with voice wholesalers. Nextocell provides live reports of CLI corruption on incoming calls to clients' networks from 120 countries.

Ce projet a été imaginé dans le but de combler le vide qui existe sur le marché pour cette population. En effet aujourd’hui l’alternative est assez mince, entre les smartphones trop complexes qui demandent un temps de formation important ou les téléphones à clapet inadaptés pour les différents handicap.

Name: Cell & Sat
Description:
Cell & Sat is incorporated as a S.A.S. (Société par Actions Simplifiée) in Paris, France and provides consulting services to cellular and satellite operators. It also develops innovative products to optimize the cost of using satellite links within mobile networks.
It associates acquired during their career a strong expertise in both the cellular and satellite fields. Cell & Sat engineers apply their expertise cellular radio systems to assist operators in technical and economical optimizations of their networks. Recent assignments concerned the impact of 4G deployments, flat IP network architectures, and fast growing services such as video distribution and Internet of Things (IoT).
A special focus of the company is new technologies to extend the coverage of telecommunications networks in rural environments. It includes the application of satellite transmission systems to complement the terrestrial infrastructure. Cell & Sat engineers designed and implemented innovative solutions to reduce the cost and improve the quality of service of satellite based cellular backhaul, in partnership with the leaders in the satellite multiplexer market.
Cell & Sat is also assisting satellite operators and manufacturers in their technical assessments, market evaluations or business plan simulations concerning the potential contribution of satellite to telecommunication networks. Recent studies included the impact of state-of-the-art broadband satellite technologies, including geostationary as well as low / medium earth orbit High Throughput Satellites “HTS”.

Rapides

Redondées

Supervisées

Evolutives

Et d'une mise en oeuvre ne nécessitant ni travaux de BTP ni délai d'intervention à rallonge. 

Notre périmètre d'intervention couvre la création d'une connexion internet de A à Z :

Notre première mission consiste à sélectionner la solution de connexion la plus adaptée à vos besoins en  fonction de votre localisation.

A partir de cette étude, nous fournissons et installons le matériel et les abonnements les plus performants.

A compter de la première connexion, nous vérifions toutes les minutes que votre connexion est opérationnelle afin d'intervenir immédiatement en cas d'anomalie.

Enfin, grâce à notre veille technologique, nous vous proposerons des évolutions au cours de notre partenariat dès qu'une avancée significative permet d'améliorer votre connexion internet ( nouvelle antenne à proximité, avènement d'une nouvelle technologie comme la 5G , arrivée de la fibre... )

Description:
OP Connect is a deeptech startup in the making, supported by UNITEC and born from French public research (CNRS – Institut d’Optique).

We’re building a next-generation free-space optical (FSO) communication system that delivers fiber-optic-level internet speeds but without the fiber. Our technology uses invisible laser beams to transmit data through the air between two compact devices, creating high-speed, secure, and low-latency links that are quick to deploy and easy to relocate.

Our system is designed to:
	•	Replace fiber in areas where deployment is too costly or impractical (white zones, ports, industrial/logistics sites).
	•	Offload the congested radio spectrum in dense environments such as, urban centers, or temporary events where Wi-Fi, 4G, or even 5G often fail.

We also address high-security markets including military and sensitive applications thanks to our highly directional links that are immune to electromagnetic interference and extremely difficult to intercept or jam.

Elles guident notre action dans notre lutte pour un monde plus équitable et durable, en faisant des femmes et des hommes les véritables acteurs de leurs choix de vie.

Cette valeur s'exprime dans la défense des droits au sein de l'entreprise, mais aussi entre salariés et chômeurs, entre générations, et plus largement entre les peuples. Elle implique également la lutte contre toute forme d'exclusion, d'inégalité et de discrimination.

3. Égalité : Nous luttons activement pour l'égalité professionnelle entre femmes et hommes. Nous nous engageons pour un égal accès aux emplois et aux responsabilités, la réduction du temps partiel subi, et l'amélioration de la conciliation entre vie personnelle et professionnelle. Description:
La sarl Contact Identification System( C.I.S ) propose CISPROCOMTM (procédé breveté) permettant à un appelant d'être identifié par son correspondant.

Aujourd’hui,  les procédures concernant les transmissions  téléphoniques sur postes fixes ou mobiles (smartphone)  permettent à la personne recevant un appel téléphonique  d'identifier la personne qui l’appelle  qu’à la seule condition qu'elle  dispose de son identité dans son répertoire électronique.

De son côté,  l'appelant n'a pas la possibilité de se faire connaître, seul son n° d'appel apparaissant sur l'écran du  téléphone de son correspondant.
La saturation des appels reçus et non identifiés conduit de plus en plus les personnes  appelées à ne pas « décrocher»  (le taux moyen de réponse aux appels  est de l'ordre de 10 à 15%). 

Afin de résoudre cette difficulté ,CISPROCOMTM donne la possibilité à l'appelant , sous différentes formes (logo , raison sociale ou toute autre forme d'identification visuelle) de  se fait connaître de son correspondant. 

CISPROCOMTM apporte de nombreux avantages :
